Callout.Name: Fire in a Stable Block
Callout.Message: Fire in a stable block with animals inside.
Callout.Advisory: Horses still in the block, owner on scene.

Script.Line: The horses are still in and the owner is in there with them.
They will not go out through the smoke. They never do.
I have got two of them out. There are four more.

Lines.Approach: The horses are still in and the owner is trying to lead them out through the smoke.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
